Then run scripts/i18n_apply.py. See site/i18n/README.md.

segments.en: Answers · what engineers ask about Glyph · Glyph
segments.tr: 问答 · 工程师关于 Glyph 的常见问题 · Glyph

segments.en: Specific answers to what engineers ask about Glyph: what stops silent breakage, React and npm, why not tooled TypeScript, and debugging in production.
segments.tr: 针对工程师关于 Glyph 的问题的具体回答：什么能防止悄无声息的破坏，React 和 npm，为什么不用配齐工具的 TypeScript，以及生产环境中的调试。

segments.en: Answers
segments.tr: 问答

segments.en: What engineers ask about Glyph.
segments.tr: 工程师关于 Glyph 的问题。

segments.en: Each answer shows a worked example and ends with what does not work yet. Start wherever your doubt is. New to Glyph? The 10-minute Start Here is the fastest first run.
segments.tr: 每个回答都有一个完整示例，并在结尾说明还有哪些做不到。从你最有疑问的地方开始读。第一次接触 Glyph？10 分钟上手是最快的入门方式。

segments.en: The problem it solves
segments.tr: 它解决的问题

segments.en: What an agent's edit can break without anyone noticing, and what Glyph does about each.
segments.tr: 智能体的编辑会在不知不觉中破坏什么，以及 Glyph 对每一种如何应对。

segments.en: What stops an agent from silently breaking my code?
segments.tr: 什么能防止智能体悄悄改坏我的代码？

segments.en: No any, no casts, exhaustive match, runtime-checked types, and colocated tests that run on every build.
segments.tr: 没有 any，没有类型断言，match 必须穷尽，类型带运行时检查，以及每次构建都会运行的就近测试。

segments.en: Will agent edits stay clean, or reformat my whole file?
segments.tr: 智能体的编辑会保持干净，还是会把整个文件重新格式化？

segments.en: A one-line change is a one-line diff. One canonical layout, nothing repacked.
segments.tr: 改一行就是一行 diff。只有一种标准排版，不会重新打包。

segments.en: Can an agent (or I) find where anything is defined?
segments.tr: 智能体（或者我）能找到任何东西的定义位置吗？

segments.en: One name, one declaration form. grep always lands on it.
segments.tr: 一个名字，一种声明形式。grep 总能找到它。

segments.en: Deciding whether to adopt it
segments.tr: 决定是否采用

segments.en: Why a language rather than more tooling, and what taking it on costs.
segments.tr: 为什么是一门语言而不是更多的工具，以及引入它的成本。

segments.en: Why TypeScript, and not Go or a new language?
segments.tr: 为什么是 TypeScript，而不是 Go 或者一门全新的语言？

segments.en: Because that's where your ecosystem is, and it's why adoption is per-file.
segments.tr: 因为你的生态就在那里，这也是为什么可以按文件引入。

segments.en: Why not just strict TypeScript + zod + eslint + ts-pattern?
segments.tr: 为什么不直接用严格模式的 TypeScript + zod + eslint + ts-pattern？

segments.en: Non-optionality: the language the agent can't config-disable.
segments.tr: 不可选：智能体无法通过配置关掉的语言。

segments.en: Is Glyph worth it if I'm not using AI?
segments.tr: 如果我不用 AI，Glyph 还值得用吗？

segments.en: Yes: the guarantees are plain engineering wins a human gets directly.
segments.tr: 值得：这些保证本身就是实实在在的工程收益，人也能直接受益。

segments.en: Can an AI reliably write a language it's barely seen?
segments.tr: AI 能可靠地写一门它几乎没见过的语言吗？

segments.en: Most of what a model knows about TypeScript carries over, and the compiler names the places it doesn't.
segments.tr: 模型对 TypeScript 的了解大多能直接沿用，编译器会指出那些不能沿用的地方。

segments.en: Will a new Glyph release break my build?
segments.tr: 新的 Glyph 版本会破坏我的构建吗？

segments.en: Projects pin the compiler exactly, so no release arrives by accident. glyph doctor says one exists; glyph upgrade takes it.
segments.tr: 项目会精确固定编译器版本，所以不会有版本意外进来。glyph doctor 告诉你有新版本；glyph upgrade 负责升级。

segments.en: Using it with your stack
segments.tr: 配合你的技术栈使用

segments.en: npm packages, an existing app, API boundaries, React.
segments.tr: npm 包、现有应用、API 边界、React。

segments.en: Can I use my existing TypeScript, JavaScript, and npm libraries?
segments.tr: 我能使用现有的 TypeScript、JavaScript 和 npm 库吗？

segments.en: Yes: import any npm package, keep a hand-written .ts shim where you need one, and import Glyph back into .ts.
segments.tr: 能：导入任何 npm 包，需要时保留手写的 .ts 适配层，还能在 .ts 中反过来导入 Glyph。

segments.en: Can I adopt Glyph inside my existing app, or is it all-or-nothing?
segments.tr: 能在现有应用里引入 Glyph 吗，还是必须全部改写？

segments.en: No rewrite: the domain core in Glyph, the rest in TypeScript. The emitted TypeScript is imported by a stock Vite app like any other module.
segments.tr: 不需要重写：领域核心用 Glyph，其余用 TypeScript。生成的 TypeScript 可以像其他模块一样被标准的 Vite 应用导入。

segments.en: Do I have to hand-write a validator for every API?
segments.tr: 每个 API 都要手写校验器吗？

segments.en: No. Declaring a type generates its validator.
segments.tr: 不用。声明类型就会生成它的校验器。

segments.en: Can I generate a typed client and server from my API spec?
segments.tr: 能根据 API 规范生成类型化的客户端和服务端吗？

segments.en: glyph gen openapi/zod/dts: committed, greppable code.
segments.tr: glyph gen openapi/zod/dts：提交到仓库、可以 grep 的代码。

segments.en: Does it work with React: components, hooks, and Context?
segments.tr: 能和 React 一起用吗：组件、hooks 和 Context？

segments.en: First-class JSX, hooks, and exhaustive reducer actions.
segments.tr: 一等支持 JSX、hooks，以及必须穷尽的 reducer action。

segments.en: How do I share mutable state between functions?
segments.tr: 怎样在函数之间共享可变状态？

segments.en: A store: a const whose .set/.update are the write-surface.
segments.tr: 用 store：一个 const，它的 .set/.update 就是写入接口。

segments.en: What you can build with it
segments.tr: 能用它构建什么

segments.en: The language and standard library, by the kind of program.
segments.tr: 按程序类型介绍语言和标准库。

segments.en: Is this a real language, or a toy with gaps?
segments.tr: 这是一门真正的语言，还是一个有很多缺口的玩具？

segments.en: Module visibility, interface bounds, defer, a match that works as any value and carries its type, and a standard library that has slice, pad_start, and fold.
segments.tr: 模块可见性、接口约束、defer、可以当作任意值使用并带有类型的 match，以及包含 slice、pad_start 和 fold 的标准库。

segments.en: Can I trust it with money, and with input I don't control?
segments.tr: 涉及金额、以及我无法控制的输入时，能信任它吗？

segments.en: Exact decimals and ids, invariants as types, injection as a compile error.
segments.tr: 精确的小数和 id，不变式即类型，注入是编译错误。

segments.en: Can I serve a web page, or only a JSON API?
segments.tr: 能提供网页，还是只能做 JSON API？

segments.en: HTML, redirects, response headers, and form posts, without a hand-written server.
segments.tr: HTML、重定向、响应头和表单提交，不需要手写服务器。

segments.en: Can I write a program someone types into?
segments.tr: 能写一个让人输入命令的程序吗？

segments.en: io.read_line answers a line as it arrives instead of waiting for stdin to close, so a REPL or a game loop works.
segments.tr: io.read_line 在每行到达时就返回，而不是等 stdin 关闭，所以 REPL 或游戏循环都能工作。

segments.en: Can I write a server, or does the process just exit?
segments.tr: 能写服务器吗，还是进程直接就退出了？

segments.en: main sets up and returns; the process stays alive while sockets and timers are pending, the same rule Node uses.
segments.tr: main 做完初始化就返回；只要还有挂起的 socket 和定时器，进程就保持运行，和 Node 的规则一样。

segments.en: Can I handle binary data, or is everything a string?
segments.tr: 能处理二进制数据吗，还是一切都是字符串？

segments.en: std/bytes is a sequence of octets, with codecs that refuse malformed input instead of skipping it, and HMACs that take a real key.
segments.tr: std/bytes 是字节序列，编解码器会拒绝格式错误的输入而不是跳过，HMAC 使用真正的密钥。

segments.en: Working with an agent
segments.tr: 与智能体协作

segments.en: Questions an agent asks the compiler before and after an edit.
segments.tr: 智能体在编辑前后向编译器提出的问题。

segments.en: Can the compiler tell me what a change will break before I make it?
segments.tr: 编译器能在我改动之前告诉我改动会破坏什么吗？

segments.en: glyph_impact: one verdict per site, from a closed list, with the reason, before you touch the file.
segments.tr: glyph_impact：在你动文件之前，为每个位置给出一个来自固定列表的结论，并附上原因。

segments.en: Can my agent ask the compiler what a symbol is before it writes code?
segments.tr: 我的智能体能在写代码之前问编译器某个符号是什么吗？

segments.en: glyph_symbol: a union's variants with the syntax that constructs each, in one call. Eleven tools, each with a glyph query verb.
segments.tr: glyph_symbol：一次调用就能拿到联合类型的各个变体，以及构造每个变体的语法。共十一个工具，每个都有对应的 glyph query 子命令。

segments.en: When the build fails, does the compiler tell my agent how to fix it?
segments.tr: 构建失败时，编译器会告诉智能体怎么修吗？

segments.en: The diagnostic carries the symbol at fault, the legal alternatives, and what a repairing edit must not break. glyph fix writes the ones the compiler settles on its own.
segments.tr: 诊断会带上出错的符号、合法的替代写法，以及修复性编辑不能破坏的东西。编译器能自行确定的修复，由 glyph fix 直接写入。

segments.en: Is the documentation my agent reads generated, or written by hand and out of date?
segments.tr: 智能体读的文档是生成的，还是手写的、已经过时的？

segments.en: glyph llms --json emits the diagnostics, the prelude, the stdlib signatures and the tool manual out of the compiler's own tables, and a gate fails when a hand-written copy disagrees.
segments.tr: glyph llms --json 从编译器自己的表中输出诊断、prelude、标准库签名和工具手册，手写的副本与之不一致时检查会失败。

segments.en: Can I stop an agent importing the raw library when we have a wrapper for it?
segments.tr: 我们已经有封装了，能阻止智能体直接导入原始库吗？

segments.en: Ban the import path in package.json and name the replacement. An import of it is E0115, and the help points at your wrapper.
segments.tr: 在 package.json 中禁止该导入路径并指明替代模块。导入它会得到 E0115，帮助信息会指向你的封装。

segments.en: Errors, editors and production
segments.tr: 错误、编辑器与生产环境

segments.en: What you see when something is wrong, from the editor to on-call.
segments.tr: 出问题时你会看到什么，从编辑器到值班。

segments.en: What's the editor, debugging, and error experience?
segments.tr: 编辑器、调试和报错的体验如何？

segments.en: A language server for any LSP editor, and errors with a stable code that name the fix.
segments.tr: 适用于任何 LSP 编辑器的语言服务器，以及带稳定错误码、会指出修复方法的报错。

segments.en: Why does Glyph catch what tsc catches, but earlier?
segments.tr: 为什么 Glyph 能发现 tsc 能发现的问题，而且更早？

segments.en: await context, a match arm with no value, and a missing mut, reported against your source instead of the emitted TypeScript.
segments.tr: await 上下文、没有值的 match 分支、缺少的 mut，都针对你的源码报告，而不是针对生成的 TypeScript。

segments.en: When a parse fails, do I find out why?
segments.tr: 解析失败时，我能知道原因吗？

segments.en: Which field, which rule it broke, the where predicate it violated, and a code to branch on.
segments.tr: 哪个字段、违反了哪条规则、违反了哪个 where 谓词，以及一个可以用来分支处理的 code。

segments.en: When it breaks in production at 3am, what does on-call see?
segments.tr: 凌晨 3 点在生产环境出问题时，值班的人会看到什么？

segments.en: Readable TS you own, source maps back to your .glyph, and a run that reports what build reports.
segments.tr: 你自己掌握的可读 TS，指回 .glyph 的 source map，以及报告内容与 build 一致的 run。

segments.en: Read them in order →
segments.tr: 按顺序阅读 →
